name: Trauma Eater
source:
The world has been scorched by WW3, and it's been years since Zissel Bramblethorne has been around people. Now, a beacon of hope glimmers on the horizon. Or is it a beacon of toxicity? 

Put on your favorite vaporwave mix, and join Zissel as they navigate a world in which traumas manifest as horrifying demons that feed on opportune moments of vulnerability. Luckily, these monsters aren't the only things out there with an insatiable hunger... 

[From [url=https://zilbergaming.itch.io/trauma-eater]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
第三次世界大战将世界化为焦土，齐塞尔·布兰布尔索恩也已有多年未曾与人打过交道。如今，地平线上闪烁起了一座希望的灯塔——抑或那其实是一座剧毒的信标？

播放你最喜爱的蒸汽波歌单，跟随齐塞尔踏入这个心理创伤会具象化为恐怖恶魔、专挑人心脆弱之际伺机吞噬的残酷世界吧。好在，荒野中怀揣着无底饥渴的，可不止这些怪物而已……

[摘自[url=https://zilbergaming.itch.io/trauma-eater]itch.io[/url]]
